an3.80:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an3.80:1.2: Sammukhā me taṃ Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ Bhagavato. Ānanda Sikhissa Abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesī ti. Bhagavā pana bhante arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kīvatakaṃ pahoti sarena viññāpetun ti? Sāvako so Ānanda, appameyyā Tathāgatā ti. Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an3.80:1.3: Bhagavato. Ānanda Sikhissa Abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesī ti.
an3.80:1.4: Bhagavā pana bhante arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kīvatakaṃ pahoti sarena viññāpetun ti?
an3.80:1.5: Sāvako so Ānanda appameyyā Tathāgatā ti. 2. Tatiyam
an3.80:2.1: pi kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.80:2.2: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an3.80:2.3: Bhagavato. Ānanda Sikhissa Abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesī ti.
an3.80:2.4: Bhagavā pana bhante arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kīvatakaṃ pahoti sarena viññāpetun ti?
an3.80:3.5: te Ānanda sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātū ti?
an3.80:3.6: Etassa Bhagavā kālo etassa Sugata kālo
an3.80:3.7: yaṃ Bhagavā bhāseyya, Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāreyyantī ti.
an3.80:3.8: Tena h' Ānanda suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmī ti.
an3.80:3.9: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
an3.80:4.1: Yāvatā Ānanda candimasuriyā pariharanti disā 'bhanti virocanā tāva sahassadhā loko.
an3.80:4.2: Tasmiṃ sahassaṃ candānaṃ sahassaṃ suriyānaṃ sahassaṃ Sinerupabbatarājānaṃ sahassaṃ Jambudīpānaṃ sahassaṃ Aparagoyānānaṃ sahassaṃ Uttarakurūnaṃ sahassaṃ Pubbavidehānaṃ cattāri mahāsamuddasahassāni cattāri mahārājasahassāni sahassaṃ Cātummahārājikānaṃ sahassaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ sahassaṃ Yāmānaṃ sahassaṃ Tusitānaṃ sahassaṃ Nimmānaratīnaṃ sahassaṃ Parinimmitavasavattīnaṃ sahassaṃ Brahmalokānaṃ.
an3.80:4.3: Ayaṃ vuccat' Ānanda sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātu.
an3.80:5.1: Yāvat' Ānanda sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātu tāva sahassadhā loko
an3.80:5.2: ayaṃ vuccat' Ānanda dvi-sahassī majjhimikā lokadhātu.
an3.80:6.1: Yāvatā c' Ānanda dvi-sahassī majjhimikā lokadhātu tāva sahassadhā loko
an3.80:7.1: Ākaṅkhamāno Ānanda Tathāgato ti-sahassī mahāsahassī-lokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyyā ti. 4.
an3.80:8.1: Yathākatham pana bhante Bhagavā tisahassī-mahāsahassī-lokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyyā ti?
an3.80:8.2: Idh' Ānanda Tathāgato tisahassī-mahāsahassī-lokadhātuṃ obhāsena phareyya
an3.80:8.3: yadā te sattā naṃ ālokaṃ sañjāneyyuṃ. atha Tathāgato ghosaṃ kareyya saddam anussāveyya.
an3.80:8.4: Evaṃ kho Ānanda Tathāgato tisahassī-mahāsahassī-lokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyyā ti. 5.
an3.80:9.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando [āyasmantaṃ Udāyim] etad avoca:--
an3.80:9.2: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
an3.80:9.3: yassa me satthā evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo ti.
an3.80:9.4: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Udāyi āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.80:9.5: Kiṃ tuyh' ettha āvuso Ānanda yadi te satthā evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo ti.
an3.80:9.6: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ etad
an3.80:9.7: avoca:-Mā h' evaṃ Udāyi mā h' evaṃ Udāyi.
an3.80:9.8: Sace Udāyi Ānando avītarāgo kālaṃ kareyya tena cittappasādena sattakkhattuṃ devesu devarajjaṃ kareyya sattakkhattuṃ imasmiṃ yeva Jambudīpe mahārajjaṃ kareyya.
an3.80:9.9: Api c' Udāyi Ānando diṭṭh' eva dhamme parinibbāyissatī
